dimensions.evidence: Observed x86-64 GCC/Clang: heap120 align4, handle2, finish16, concurrent168 bytes. Handle slot1..16/gen1..3 and retired4; no pointer packing.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: ISO C typed structs; runtime validation; caller initialization.

dimensions.evidence: Sixteen embedded two-edge objects, sixteen gray entries, root counts and generations. Strong roots/edges retain; already marked unreachable nodes can float until next cycle. No tracing of arbitrary native pointers.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Reachability invariant plus caller root discipline.

dimensions.evidence: Fresh stationary init; generation retirement after3 uses; finish owner+revision bound to one instance. All workers joined and tokens discarded before terminal exhaustion retirement or close.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime finite counter checks plus external lifecycle discipline.

dimensions.evidence: Core serialized; wrapper same mutex for every graph/root/work/revision access. No exposed raw payload. Copying handle bits does not retain; a read borrower needs protection until retain succeeds.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: POSIX synchronization and runtime generation check; no ownership type enforcement.

dimensions.evidence: Embedded capacity only. BLACK shades children, GRAY queues object, RESTART reseeds all roots. Root255, full/retired pool and revision65535 reject unchanged. No malloc in marking core; pthread implementation allocation is outside target core contract.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime capacity/preflight checks; source and host generated-code inspection.

dimensions.evidence: No object relocation. Allocation and scan stage/copy120-byte heap; step therefore has fixed-capacity copying overhead in addition to edge scans. Each finish/response is copied. Queue work is O(V+E) between restarts, but whole-state staging invalidates a general linear machine-cost claim.

Commit scans16 slots without recursion. Normal close requires empty/inactive pool; exhausted revision permits whole-pool retirement only after external quiescence. Mutex acquisition can block without a bound.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime phase checks and caller join boundary.

dimensions.evidence: O2 actual assembly: wrapper dispatches directly to core functions and pthread_mutex_lock/unlock. GCC allocation/step include stack-check failure helper; Clang allocation calls restart helper. No claim this hosted image is freestanding or helper-free.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Inspected actual objdump records; compiler-specific observation.

dimensions.evidence: Actual late-store and late-root pthread schedules plus100 cycles against1000 mutation iterations. Empty queue retains active barriers; commit revalidates revision/work under same lock. No parallel tracing, lock-free progress, fairness, owner-death recovery or asynchronous cancellation guarantee.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: POSIX lock/unlock, generation/revision checks, source proof and executed TSan cases.

dimensions.evidence: All valid failure paths preserve controls/output except documented synchronization environment abort. Epoch cannot wrap; a failed root release at exhaustion requires whole-instance shutdown rather than silent wrap. Stale candidate retry rescans current work.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime checks and exact-state/response negative tests.

dimensions.evidence: Actual six GCC/Clang O0/O2/O3 clean/no-change/header builds recorded. O2 GCC .579249/.039125/.628578 seconds; Clang .721636/.078529/.542559. Filesystem/load noise and single-build samples prohibit general rankings.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Recorded commands and observed timings, not language guarantees.

dimensions.evidence: O2 whole-image text/data/bss GCC16965/656/16; Clang18835/640/16. Core+original runtime+wrapper linked. Observed frames allocate/step/call/commit GCC176/160/112/8; Clang152/0/88/0 bytes. Clang zero may use registers/red-zone/inlining; not a zero-stack or worst-case-program claim.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Actual size and .su artifacts; host compiler/ABI observation.

dimensions.evidence: No persistence, wire or process ABI for control/token structs. Host POSIX wrapper is not an MCU adapter. Reference comparison is historical V8 worklists/barriers/finalization, not an engine equivalence.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Explicit contract and separate platform source authority.

timing_scope: 270 retained samples +18 discarded warmups;1000 complete equal-contract graph lifecycles each. Initialization/checks/sweep/cleanup/staging included; first-cycle scans2000/3000/4000 per sample and restarts0/0/1000. No timed parallel speedup or universal latency claim.

sealed_decision.choice: Bounded explicit gray worklist with gray allocation and mutex-protected split finish for the concurrent teaching adapter.
sealed_decision.reason: Gray allocation gives ordinary scan ownership; all policies remain implemented for comparison. A finite revision detects the prepared-sweep interval without introducing relaxed-memory proof obligations.
sealed_decision.rejected_overclaim: A mutex-safe collector is not a parallel, lock-free or starvation-free collector. Larger counters do not establish indefinite identity safety.
sealed_decision.reopen_when: Change root publication, expose payload pointers, introduce parallel tracing or remove global exclusion; rederive barriers and termination before accepting results.
